newsitem.title: USA: Cornerstone sees weak Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Cornerstone sees weak Q2 results.

text.p: Cornerstone Imaging Inc announced Tuesday it expects earnings for its second quarter will be well below analysts' expectations.

The company said in a statement it expects earnings per share for the second quarter, ended June 30, will be about breakeven compared to a loss of $0.05 a share in the year-ago second quarter. Analysts' had expected the company to earn $0.11 a share for the quarter, according to First Call.
Cornerstone said revenues for the quarter will be in the range of $21 million to $22.5 million.

The company attributed the weaker results to slower than anticipated growth in the market for production document imaging systems. Revenues for Cornerstone's display division will not meet expectations and will be in the range of $18 million to $19.5 million, a decline of 5 percent to 10 percent from the same period in 1996.
Revenues at Cornerstone's software division will be higher at about $3 million, an increase of 67 percent compared to the second quarter of 1996.
